title: Counterfeit Detection Result (Counterfeit Vision -> Command Centre)
description: Output emitted by the Counterfeit Vision CV model (Adharshan) for a single note image. The command centre consumes this to render the note-scan card and feed the fusion LLM.

event_id.description: Unique id for this scanned note.

denomination.description: Detected note denomination. Widened from [100,200,500,2000] — the optical layer can distinguish Rs10/20/50 too, and forcing them to 'unknown' (or, before the hue windows were fixed, mislabelling a lavender Rs100 as a Rs2000) lost real information on a seizure record.

missing_features.description: Security features found absent/failed (feature-level detection). Powers the 'why fake' explanation. ACTIONABLE failures only — measurements taken on an unlocated note are excluded, since the verdict was not permitted to use them either. Reported on genuine verdicts too: a genuine already implies fewer than two actionable failures, so a non-empty list here reads as 'cleared, with one soft flag' rather than hidden evidence.

image_ref.description: Path/URL to the captured note image for the UI.

heatmap_ref.description: Path/URL to the class-activation heatmap overlay — highlights which regions drove the decision. See analysis.heatmap_method for which method produced it.

location_hint.description: Optional seizure location for the crime map (cross-domain overlap).

triage.description: Pre-CNN deterministic triage. decision 'obvious_fake' or 'unscannable' means the CNN was never consulted — the verdict came from these measurements alone. Additive evidence like fraud-shield's `verification`; never contradicts the pipeline.

convicts.description: True only when the measurement reached the strict threshold a genuine note cannot reach. A failed check with convicts=false is recorded evidence that the verdict was NOT allowed to act on.

conclusive.description: A single conclusive tell convicts on its own (e.g. zero ink colour).

narrative.description: LLM-written 'why' over the failed checks (Claude -> Groq -> Gemini -> template chain). Null when triage passed.

serial.description: Serial-number layer (manual/UI-entered serial). nonsense = impossible RBI format; suspicious = classic prop pattern (fancy genuine numbers exist); duplicate = same serial sighted before in the registry — a counterfeit printing run or a rescan. Any non-valid status blocks a genuine certification (caps to uncertain), never convicts.

source.description: Where the serial came from. 'vision' means the semantic layer read it off the note.

vision_review.description: Semantic review — the only layer that reads what is PRINTED on the note, as opposed to measuring its print physics. ALWAYS present: `available` false with a `status` of unavailable_no_key/unavailable_error/disabled means no model looked, which is why a `genuine` reached without it carries a capped confidence and a caveat. A wrong portrait or header CONVICTS (this is a fact about the note's content, not a fragile surface measurement); a SPECIMEN overprint or denomination mismatch caps to uncertain. Never acquits.

available.description: True only when a vision model actually inspected the note.

serial_text.description: Serial read off the note; feeds the sighting registry when no serial was typed.

tampering_signs.description: Visible edit artefacts: pasted regions, mismatched fonts, cut-and-paste edges.

analysis.description: How the scan was actually performed — the provenance a verdict needs to be auditable.

note_located.description: True when a note outline was found and perspective-corrected. False means the whole frame was resized instead, so every fixed-geometry measurement was reading background and none of them were allowed to affect the verdict.

feature_checks_applied.description: Whether the security-feature checks were trusted enough to influence the verdict.

heatmap_method.description: Which method produced heatmap_ref. grad_cam is class-specific ('what drove FAKE'); eigen_cam is class-agnostic ('where the model looked') and is substituted on low-memory hosts. These are different explanations and the payload previously called both Grad-CAM.

semantic_failures.description: Content-level reasons for the verdict (wrong portrait, wrong header, SPECIMEN overprint, denomination mismatch). No missing_features enum value describes these — that list names security features, not content.

caveats.description: What this verdict did NOT check. Present on a `genuine` reached without the semantic layer.

denomination_source.description: Present when the denomination did not come from the optical hue windows. 'vision' means the semantic layer read the printed numeral — optical hue cannot separate Rs10/Rs20/Rs200, which share one warm colour band.
